semanticChecks.meaning: Br has the qualified Lr caller and exported getter; no invented direct UI call.
Installed IDs are grouped with size100 and metadata batches joined with Promise.all.
Installed order/access flags survive metadata enrichment; local read errors propagate.
Suggestion app context requires callable+enabled inventory and saved configuration.
Prompt approval settings conservatively exclude the complete app from generated context.
Connector IDs are disabled on missing token, TOS failure, or non-null personalization blurb; no token fetch when there are no eligible connectors.
Prompt slug uniqueness is checked over all callable+enabled apps, before disabled-app omission.
Lookup failure and a successful empty inventory remain distinct in the projectless early-return condition.
Suggestion lookup fallback disables all app categories in generated config; it does not prove task success.
Main namespace members join exact frozen CJS getters for inventory, predicate and generator.
A guarded Codex background path positively consumes this support mechanism; no whole-mode classification follows.
Host-selected eligibility RPC shares the same inventory but propagates errors and is injected under ambientSuggestions.
Renderer query has host/account key, caller enablement, five-minute staleness and disabled retry; absent optional service returns false.
Batch helper is a separate module/factory import boundary; package identity and replacement compatibility are not inferred from its short name.
The ChatGPT HTTP boundary is called with CODEX SKU; endpoint branding alone does not establish ChatGPT-only usage.
Both original partial callee/argument anchors join exact complete AST calls without changing source identity.
